input: Clear[h,s,k,ud,ur,pd,pir,qq,ll]; con=h^2-s^2-k(ud+ur)-ll; hd=-h^2-2s^2-k(ud+2ur+3pd)/2+ll; sd=-3h s+k pir; udd=-3h(ud+pd)-qq; urd=-4h ur-2s pir+qq; <|"constraint_propagation_residual"->Expand[2h hd-2s sd-k(udd+urd)+2h con],"source_cancellation"->Expand[-qq+qq],"source_mismatch_residual"->Expand[2h hd-2s sd-k(udd+urd+deltaQ)+2h con],"jump_constraint_change"->Expand[(h^2-s^2-k((ud-deltaU)+(ur+deltaU))-ll)-con]|>
